 Fenix joins Teams Mexico for Survivor Series match
 Share 
 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Print Telegram LINE 
 By Colin Vassallo 
 11/14/2026 
 The third member of Team Mexico for the Survivor Series match is AAA Cruiserweight champion Rey Fenix.
 Rey Mysterio introduced Fenix as part of Team Mexico in a backstage segment also involving Cody Rhodes and CM Punk.
 Fenix now joins his brother Penta and Mysterio for the traditional five-on-five match with two other names still yet to be decided.
 Team USA, captained by Cody Rhodes, also has three members so far, including CM Punk and Je’Von Evans.
